High-resolution (600 dpi) scan of the printed Decipher card [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]] (Coruscant, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Coruscant/Coruscant Light/Ki-Adi-Mundi.tif</code> (Drive file ID <code>0B8qrn2aDKgPea1lhMFlpM1NoN0k</code>).

Original TIFF: <code>Ki-Adi-Mundi.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,339,856 bytes, SHA-256 <code>b20baa79131a51af973807884e7d4f4fd6e4519abd717a088b99bd25ca9f4957</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the scan, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

This scan shows the printed wording. Decipher’s pre-release online gallery depicts an earlier text at [[:File:Cor-L-kiadimundi-decipher-archive.jpg]].

Credit: scan by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
